services.name: Sacramento Police Department
services.description: City police for Sacramento; call the non-emergency dispatch line to reach an officer or report a crime that is not in progress.

services.name: Sacramento Police Department - Missing Persons Unit
services.description: SPD investigations unit that handles missing person cases; there is no waiting period to report someone missing.

services.name: Sacramento County Sheriff's Office
services.description: County sheriff serving unincorporated Sacramento County; call the non-emergency line for reports and assistance outside city limits.

services.name: FBI Sacramento Field Office
services.description: Federal field office covering the Eastern District of California (including Sacramento); takes reports of suspicious activity and crime 24/7 and works missing person and MMIP cases on federal and tribal lands.

services.name: Sacramento Native American Health Center
services.description: Urban Indian health center offering medical, dental, behavioral health, and traditional healing services to the Native community and others.

services.name: WEAVE
services.description: Sacramento County's primary crisis service for survivors of domestic violence and sexual assault, with a 24/7 support and information line staffed by trained peer counselors.

services.name: California Indian Legal Services - Sacramento (Central Office)
services.description: Nonprofit law firm protecting Indian rights; provides legal help to Native individuals and tribes across central California, including family, ICWA, and victim-rights matters.

services.name: Sacramento County DA Victim/Witness Assistance Program
services.description: District Attorney program offering crisis intervention, court accompaniment, advocacy, and help applying for state victim compensation; the line is monitored daily.

services.name: San Francisco Police Department
services.description: City police for San Francisco; use the non-emergency line for situations that need police but not an immediate response.

services.name: SFPD Missing Persons Unit
services.description: Dedicated SFPD unit for missing person cases; you can report a missing person right away, with no waiting period.

services.name: San Francisco Sheriff's Office
services.description: County sheriff for the City and County of San Francisco; handles jails, civil process, and court and building security.
services.address: City Hall, Room 456, 1 Dr. Carlton B. Goodlett Place, San Francisco, CA 94102

services.name: FBI San Francisco Field Office
services.description: Federal field office covering 15 northern California counties including San Francisco; takes reports of suspicious activity and crime 24/7 and assists on missing person and MMIP cases.
services.address: 450 Golden Gate Avenue, 13th Floor, San Francisco, CA 94102

services.name: Native American Health Center - San Francisco
services.description: Community health center serving the urban Native community with medical, dental, behavioral health, and community wellness services.

services.name: La Casa de las Madres
services.description: San Francisco domestic violence agency with 24/7 hotlines, emergency shelter, and drop-in support for adults and teens.

services.name: San Francisco Women Against Rape
services.description: Rape crisis center offering a 24-hour hotline, counseling, accompaniment to hospitals and police, and advocacy for sexual assault survivors.

services.name: San Francisco District Attorney - Victim Services Division
services.description: DA division providing advocates who guide victims and families through the criminal justice process, restitution, and victim compensation.
services.address: 350 Rhode Island Street, Suite 400N, San Francisco, CA 94103

services.name: Oakland Police Department
services.description: City police for Oakland; the non-emergency line is answered 24 hours a day, and the Police Administration Building front desk is open around the clock.

services.name: Oakland Police Department - Missing Persons Unit
services.description: OPD unit that manages roughly 1,500 missing person cases a year; call to follow up on a report or share information (call or text 911 to make the initial report).

services.name: Alameda County Sheriff's Office
services.description: County sheriff serving unincorporated Alameda County; call the non-emergency line to report a crime or request assistance outside city police jurisdictions.

services.name: FBI San Francisco Field Office (serves Oakland)
services.description: Federal field office whose territory includes Alameda County and Oakland; takes reports of suspicious activity and crime 24/7 and assists on missing person and MMIP cases.
services.address: 450 Golden Gate Avenue, 13th Floor, San Francisco, CA 94102

services.name: Native American Health Center - Oakland (7 Directions)
services.description: Flagship Oakland clinic of the Native American Health Center, offering medical, dental, behavioral health, and community wellness services rooted in Native culture.

services.name: Alameda Health System - SARRT (Sexual Assault Response and Recovery Team)
services.description: Hospital-based program at the Wilma Chan Highland Hospital Campus in Oakland; now the county's responding agency for sexual assault forensic exams and advocacy, with a 24/7 crisis line for sexual assault, domestic violence, and trafficking survivors.

services.name: Tri-Valley Haven - Alameda County 24-Hour Crisis Hotline
services.description: Operates the 24-hour crisis hotline serving survivors of domestic violence and sexual assault county-wide (in partnership with Alameda Health System after BAWAR's 2025 closure), plus shelter and counseling from its Livermore center.

services.name: Family Violence Law Center
services.description: Alameda County nonprofit providing free legal help (restraining orders, family law) and 24/7 crisis intervention for domestic violence survivors.

services.name: Alameda County DA Victim-Witness Assistance Division
services.description: District Attorney advocates who help crime victims and witnesses with their rights, safety, court support, and connections to services.

services.name: San Jose Police Department
services.description: City police for San Jose; call the non-emergency line for police matters that do not need an immediate response.
services.address: 201 W Mission Street, San Jose, CA 95110

services.name: San Jose Police Department - Missing Persons Unit
services.description: SJPD detail handling both adult and juvenile missing person cases; reports can be filed immediately.
services.address: 201 W Mission Street, San Jose, CA 95110

services.name: Santa Clara County Sheriff's Office
services.description: County sheriff serving unincorporated Santa Clara County and several contract cities; use the non-emergency dispatch line to reach a deputy.
services.address: 55 W Younger Ave, San Jose, CA 95110

services.name: FBI San Francisco Field Office (serves San Jose)
services.description: Federal field office whose Bay Area territory includes Santa Clara County and San Jose; takes reports of suspicious activity and crime 24/7 and assists on missing person and MMIP cases.
services.address: 450 Golden Gate Avenue, 13th Floor, San Francisco, CA 94102

services.name: Indian Health Center of Santa Clara Valley
services.description: Native-led community health center offering medical, dental, behavioral health, and wellness services for Native families and the wider community.

services.name: YWCA Golden Gate Silicon Valley
services.description: Santa Clara County's crisis agency for domestic violence, sexual assault, and trafficking survivors, with a 24/7 bilingual support line, shelter, therapy, and legal services.
services.address: 375 S. Third St., San Jose, CA 95112

services.name: Eureka Police Department
services.description: City police for Eureka; call non-emergency dispatch to reach an officer or report a crime that is not in progress.

services.name: Humboldt County Sheriff's Office
services.description: County sheriff serving Humboldt County's unincorporated communities, including much of the rural north coast; call the non-emergency line for reports and assistance.

services.name: Yurok Tribal Police
services.description: Tribal law enforcement for the Yurok Reservation and Klamath River communities; a first call for incidents and missing relatives on Yurok lands.
services.address: 230 Klamath Blvd, Ste. B, Klamath, CA 95548

services.name: Hoopa Valley Tribal Police
services.description: Tribal law enforcement for the Hoopa Valley Reservation; a first call for incidents and missing relatives on Hoopa lands (mailing address PO Box 1341, Hoopa, CA 95546).

services.name: United Indian Health Services - Potawot Health Village
services.description: Tribally governed health system for Native people of Humboldt and Del Norte counties, with medical, dental, behavioral health, and community programs at its Potawot Health Village campus in Arcata.

services.name: Two Feathers Native American Family Services
services.description: Native-led family services agency for Humboldt County offering culturally grounded mental health counseling, youth programs, and family support.
services.address: 1560 Betty Court, Suite A, McKinleyville, CA 95519

services.name: North Coast Rape Crisis Team
services.description: Rape crisis center for Humboldt and Del Norte counties with 24/7 hotlines, accompaniment, and advocacy for survivors of sexual violence.

services.name: Humboldt Domestic Violence Services
services.description: Humboldt County domestic violence agency with a 24/7 support line, safety planning, shelter, and advocacy.

services.name: California Indian Legal Services - Northern Office (McKinleyville)
services.description: CILS office serving Del Norte, Humboldt, Mendocino, Siskiyou, and Trinity counties with free or low-cost legal help for Native individuals and tribes (formerly located in Eureka).
services.address: 2355 Central Avenue, Suite C, McKinleyville, CA 95519

services.name: Humboldt County DA Victim Witness Assistance Program
services.description: District Attorney program offering crisis intervention, emergency assistance, court support, and help with victim compensation for crime victims and their families.

services.name: Redding Police Department
services.description: City police for Redding; dial the main number and press 1 to be routed to SHASCOM dispatch for non-emergencies.

services.name: Shasta County Sheriff's Office
services.description: County sheriff serving Shasta County's unincorporated communities; call to speak with a deputy about non-emergency reports and assistance.

services.name: FBI Sacramento Field Office (serves Redding)
services.description: Federal field office covering the Eastern District of California, which includes Shasta County and Redding; takes reports of suspicious activity and crime 24/7 and assists on missing person and MMIP cases.

services.name: Redding Rancheria Tribal Health System
services.description: Tribally operated health system offering medical, dental, and behavioral health care at its Redding clinics, including the Tribal Health Center and Churn Creek Healthcare.

services.name: One SAFE Place
services.description: Shasta County's center for survivors of domestic violence and sexual assault, with a 24/7 crisis line, emergency shelter, advocacy, and support services.
